name: Pepper (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Pepper (Capsicum annuum) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170108 (Peppers, sweet, red, raw)
Song et al. 2023, Comprehensive fruit quality assessment of green pepper (Capsicum annuum L.), PMC9871545 (organic acids by HPLC)
Wahyuni et al., metabolite profiling of Capsicum (quinic acid pericarp reference)
Frontiers Plant Sci 2025 doi:10.3389/fpls.2025.1719537 (ascorbic acid by ripening stage)
provenance.curation_notes: Curated as ripe red sweet Capsicum annuum. Dominant carbon/energy sources are the free hexoses glucose (1.94 g) + fructose (2.26 g, ~230 mM combined) with sucrose absent, backed by citric acid as the dominant organic acid (~0.37 g/100g) plus malic and TCA-cycle acids; ascorbate is exceptionally high (128 mg/100g) and doubles as a reducing organic acid. Organic acids, previously entirely missing, were the main gap filled. Fumaric-acid value is high and variety-dependent (flagged). Removed 13 non-
curation_added: individual free sugars with amounts (glucose 1.94, fructose 2.26 g/100g; sucrose absent)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
